NAME: Explicit Weak-Cash Payout Switch
EXPRESSION: MUL(MIN(IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(prstkc, at), 1)), IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(dvc, at), 1)))), NEG(IND_ZSCORE(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: Increasing repurchases while reducing dividends predicts lower returns when operating cash profitability is weak.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: Requiring both sides of the payout switch distinguishes a deliberate move from committed dividends toward discretionary repurchases from a noisy change in their net difference. Weak cash quality makes the switch more indicative of payout fragility or an attempt to preserve flexibility without formally eliminating distributions.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Net-Borrowed Dividend Strain
EXPRESSION: MUL(MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(dltis, dltr), at)), IND_RANK(RATIO(dvc, at))), NEG(IND_ZSCORE(MA(RATIO(SUB(oancf, dvc), at), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: Dividend distributions accompanied by net debt expansion predict lower returns when post-dividend operating cash is weak.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: Netting debt retirement removes refinancing activity and isolates genuine balance-sheet expansion used alongside distributions. This measurement change should sharpen the distinction between debt-supported payout strain and firms that issue and retire debt concurrently without increasing leverage.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Equity-Funded Dividend Strain
EXPRESSION: MUL(MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(sstk, at)), IND_RANK(RATIO(dvc, at))), NEG(IND_ZSCORE(MA(RATIO(SUB(oancf, dvc), at), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: Simultaneous equity issuance and dividend payments predict lower returns when operating cash remaining after distributions is weak.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: The signal identifies firms that dilute shareholders while preserving a dividend despite inadequate internal funding. It provides a direct financing-source comparison with debt-funded dividend strain, testing whether the adverse mechanism is generic payout support or specifically borrowing-driven.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Cash-Quality Leveraged Share Retirement
EXPRESSION: MUL(MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(dltis, dltr), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(GROWTH(csho, 1)))), IND_ZSCORE(MA(RATIO(SUB(oancf, dp), at), 3)))
HYPOTHESIS: Debt-financed share-count contraction predicts higher returns when recurring cash capacity is strong and lower returns when cash capacity is weak.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Actual share-count contraction verifies that increased leverage produces a realized reduction in outside claims rather than repurchase spending offset by new issuance. The design isolates whether the prior leveraged-repurchase evidence is stronger when financing effectiveness is measured by the balance-sheet outcome.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
